findings.title: Event work is already committed (API HEAD e24b1e0), plan says no commits
findings.detail: c:/Project/running-event-api: commit e24b1e0 'Handle nullable event and race fields' holds FEAT-001 items 1-4 (event.view.ts defaults, event-fields.ts, validators, slip-file.ts, tests), so the working-tree diff alone omits them. Reviewed via git show; they meet the plan. Plan section 0/O5 said no commits, so mention it to the user.

findings.title: Note cap is a soft limit
findings.detail: api src/services/order/order-notes.service.ts addNote: countDocuments then create is not atomic, so two simultaneous requests can reach 101 notes; loadDetailExtras limit(100) hides the extra one. Documented in a code comment, acceptable on standalone Mongo.

findings.title: Admin UI not exercised in a browser
findings.detail: verification.md says dialogs, nudge, timeline and notes UI were only typechecked/built. API behaviour has 137 live assertions. Do a manual smoke pass before release.

findings.title: MongoDB 5.0+ requirement from the shipping $lookup
findings.detail: api src/services/shipping.service.ts uses $lookup with localField/foreignField plus pipeline (5.0+), as planned in O2. If production Mongo is older, shipping search fails; switch to the let + $expr form then.
